budget_items.topic: Household Hazardous Waste IMA – Lunenburg annual assessment
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg pays an annual assessment of $5,354 under a formula based on equalized property valuation and population; Ashby would pay both capital and operating assessments under the same formula.
budget_items.quote: lunenburg pays an annual assessment of $5,354 which is based upon a formula which takes into account both equalized property valuation (50%) and population

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Money is available for codification of the By Laws; one bid was received, higher than the Town Manager had hoped.
budget_items.quote: one bid has been received in the amount of $16,000.
